content: Bounded-chunk DELETE: standard pattern is a CTE selecting ctid (or PK) with ORDER BY + LIMIT n, then DELETE ... WHERE ctid IN (that set), looped until affected rows < n, committing per chunk. ctid is safe only because the select is re-run each iteration. Chunking reduces lock duration and contention and bounds WAL/bloat; autovacuum may lag a bulk purge. COMMIT inside a loop requires a procedure/DO block in SQL, or an application-side loop.
